bounded_checks.findings: Corrections: (1) removed both guide-library constant regions that existed only on the upstream drawn page - the stretch between the 10-bp guide barcode and the oMCB1672 site is now a placeholder, and the post-spacer region is derived as the complement of oSP2053's sgRNA-specific 3' half; (2) the indexed P7 primer was modelled with the full 34-base TruSeq Read 2 but the source prints only its first 22 bases - fixed in the oligo list and in the guide PCR geometry; (3) the guide route no longer splits a hypothetical pre-branch pool: per Note 3 and the Methods it starts from 2.5 uL of the finished ~150 nM scATAC library, with biotinylated oSP2053 linear amplification (25 cycles, 2X NEBNext), MinElute, streptavidin MyOne C1 capture in B&W buffer with scATAC fragments washed away, 15-cycle PCR2 off the beads, then magnet and keep the supernatant (beads with the biotinylated strands discarded) and MinElute; (4) named the previously generic 'opposite-end ATAC primer' as oSP1735 spiked into the GEM master mix and added it to the oligo list; (5) read uses corrected so the 16-nt cell-barcode index read is an extracted identifier rather than demultiplexing. Four page highlights now state the enrichment template, the supernatant endpoint, the untranscribed pSP618 interior and the optional 10-bp barcode route.
